candidate_relations.reason: The bronchoscopic finding of pronounced swelling in bilateral arytenoid epiglottis folds is a manifestation/component of the broader ATAD3A-related neurodevelopmental syndrome (HAYOS). The candidate does not capture the genetic etiology, the multisystem involvement (hypotonia, cardiac defects, corneal opacity, brain imaging abnormalities, EEG changes), or the ATAD3A heterozygous variant that defines the reference diagnosis. Laryngomalacia is a symptom-level descriptor, not the final diagnostic entity requested.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Addresses only the laryngeal/airway finding (arytenoid epiglottis fold swelling causing stridor) rather than the underlying syndromic diagnosis of Harel-Yoon syndrome caused by ATAD3A mutation

case_quality_flags: ATAD3A heterozygous variant c.1517A>C (p.Q506P) is a strong anchor for Harel-Yoon syndrome; multisystem features (hypotonia, cardiac, ocular, neuroimaging) are consistent with HAYOS
Maternal history of strabismus, cataract, and cardiac anomalies may suggest dominant inheritance pattern relevant to ATAD3A-related disorder
